mapper.select: select contract_id, contract_name, contract_abstract, contract_status, activation_time, end_time, create_time, issuer_id, issuer_entity_id, partuser_id, partuser_entity_id, sign_time, expansion_item, issuer_name, partuser_name from sp.contract where ( (#{userIdentityCode} is not null and issuer_entity_id = #{userIdentityCode}) or (#{consumerSubjectPlatformUserId} is not null and consumer_subject_platform_user_id = #{consumerSubjectPlatformUserId}) or ( #{consumerPlatformUserId} is not null and ( #{consumerSubjectPlatformUserId} is null or #{consumerPlatformUserId} != #{consumerSubjectPlatformUserId} ) and consumer_platform_user_id = #{consumerPlatformUserId} ) ) and contract_status in ('03', '05') and strategy is not null and btrim(strategy) != '' and strategy::json #>> '{subjectInfo,dataProductId}' = #{productId} order by coalesce(sign_time, create_time) desc nulls last, contract_id desc
